revised_prompts:
Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot, template: webtoon-shot-v1. 1536x2048 pixels, keep a 6% safe margin. Single close-up shot, high angle, portrait-lens feel, camera positioned between Theo’s line of sight and Bram’s hand over the dining table, with a subtle push-in feeling. Focus tightly on Bram’s hand holding an old sealed letter and his stiff fingers. Leave quiet negative space in the upper left for dialogue.

Scene purpose: visually show Bram’s tiny hiding motion and, through the worn seal, imply the estate’s debt.

Composition: 
- Bram Waldhart at left 46%, top 33%, width 42%, height 50%, foreground. Only his strong middle-aged hand and forest-green doublet sleeve are prominently visible; face out of frame. Action: lifting the letter and pulling it inward toward his body to hide it. Preserve: sturdy weathered hand, forest-green sleeve, no decorative ring, no heraldry.
- Theo Waldhart at left 4%, top 62%, width 22%, height 22%, foreground. Only small fingertips and part of brown hair / side of head visible, with partial questioning expression. Gaze fixed on the letter’s edge. Preserve: small hand, chestnut-brown hair, blue-gray sleeve.

Background/location: Walt-fort dining hall table close crop only, based on the dining hall reference. Use a high, intimate close composition centered on the letter seal. Show bread piece and soup bowl on the table nearby. Depth layers: Theo’s fingertips in near layer, Bram’s hand and letter in primary focus, table food slightly behind. Calm indoor light; only the wax seal catches a low reflection.

Visual treatment: refined 2D webtoon close-up, line emphasis on letter edges and fingers, faded paper / browns / deep forest green palette, tactile unreadable document texture, mood of hidden burden. No readable writing on the letter whatsoever.

Continuity: screen direction right-to-left. Entering state: Bram has just picked up the dropped letter. Leaving state: Bram hides the letter, Theo catches onto the wordless idea of debt.

Negative space regions must remain visually quiet: upper left area and lower right area. Generate no speech balloons, captions, readable text, watermark, or signature.

Avoid: speech bubbles, captions, readable text, modern mail, exaggerated debt wording, duplicate characters, visible full faces, watermark, signature.
